tool: built-in image_gen via codex exec (gpt-6-astra, high effort)
format: opaque PNG originals copied without pixel editing. The tool has no size control and returned about 1020x1540 (2:3), not the requested 9:19.5; previews are 390 px wide JPEG. Not in the app asset catalog.

assets.name: OnboardingHardMomentV1.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one tall portrait full-bleed CircleU app onboarding scene, fully opaque, no transparency, aspect ratio about 9:19.5 (for example 1290x2796). Match the supplied CircleU artwork reference: clean smooth rounded geometric silhouettes, sophisticated matte 2D editorial illustration with gentle restrained shading, upper-left light, suitable for students and young adults. Palette navy #0D1421, royal blue #054FC9, ice #F5FAFF, sky #47C7FF, small warm orange #FF8538 accents. No sketch lines, hatching, texture, grain, outlines, glossy plastic, clay, photorealism, text, lettering, signage, watermark, frame or border. Calm, quiet and soft, not cheerful-loud; low contrast, gentle gradients, few elements. Layout: all scene content sits in the top 65% of the image. The bottom 35% of the image is a smooth vertical fade into a completely plain, flat, empty ice tone #F5FAFF, with no objects, ground detail, shapes, reflections or texture there at all; the scene dissolves softly into it. Pingu stands in the middle third of the height, centred horizontally, about 25% of image height. Character identity reference: BrandAvatar.png. Preserve EXACT same recognisable Pingu identity, one curved crest, navy head/body, white heart-shaped face and belly, small oval dark eyes, tiny closed orange beak, icy blue scarf, plump proportions, orange feet. Same gentle dimensional shading as reference; do not redesign its face, add eyebrows, blush, clothes or props except those requested. Scene: early evening light rain on a quiet rounded city street, dusk blue palette from royal blue to soft lavender-blue, a few simple rounded buildings with warm orange lit windows, soft diagonal rain streaks kept minimal. Pingu stands under a small plain rounded awning, dry, looking slightly down and to the side, thoughtful and calm, not sad, no tears. No people, no cars, no umbrellas.
